title: Truckee River Rafting
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We offer self-guided rafting trips down the beautiful Truckee River, with commercial-grade rafts available for groups of all sizes. Your adventure begins in Tahoe City and floats through scenic meadows, mountain views, and gentle rapids, ending at the iconic River Ranch Restaurant. The trip takes about 2-3 hours and is fun for all ages (2 and up). Feel free to bring a soft cooler with snacks and drinks to enjoy
